system.description:
Action: Dexterity (Stealth) check against each observer's Wisdom check, or its passive awareness if it is not looking (see Disengage & Hide).

Combat Manoeuvres, Action: uses your action.

  • Hide (action): make a Dexterity (Stealth) check.
  • An observer who is actively looking makes a Wisdom check against it; one who is not uses its passive awareness (10 + Wisdom modifier).
  • You are hidden from each observer your check beats.
  • You may attempt it only while unobserved or in cover or concealment.
  • Surprise always uses the Wisdom check.
  • Unseen: an attack against a creature that cannot see you has Advantage, and your attack against a creature you cannot see has Disadvantage.

Press Use to roll the Dexterity check.
